review.evidence: On 2026-09-11 the administrator stated in the maintainer session that review had passed and explicitly instructed publication of formal acceptance.

decision_scope: A specific administrator acceptance decision for these exact historical inputs. This is not an assertion that the two-independent-reviewer policy has been fulfilled and does not enable automatic acceptance for other inputs.

archival_policy.primary: GitHub immutable release assets under acceptance-dgg-cost-v1-20260911
archival_policy.backup: Identical files in the Git tree pinned by the release tag and retained on acceptance/dgg-cost-v1-20260911
archival_policy.retention: Retain indefinitely for the lifetime of this repository; do not replace or delete historical acceptance assets or tags. Publish a new record for corrections or revocation.
archival_policy.recovery: Download either the release assets or the tagged Git archive; verify SHA256SUMS and every evidence MANIFEST.json entry before relying on the record. Repeat after storage migration and at least annually.
archival_policy.failure_domain: Release assets and Git backup share GitHub as their hosting provider; no independent-provider backup is asserted.

historical_reports: Original machine reports retain formal_status=pending as of their execution. This later administrator decision is recorded separately without modifying their bytes.
scope_exclusions: Changed source, dependency, statement, policy or verifier inputs require fresh bound verification and a new decision.
No award eligibility, priority, prize amount or recipient decision.
catalog: The current machine catalog has no administrator-acceptance integration and may continue to display pending. This versioned release is the publication of this specific acceptance decision.
